title: NOVONIX’ Mike O’Kronley Featured on S&P Global EnergyCents Podcast
summary: NOVONIX’ Mike O’Kronley was featured on the latest episode of the S&P Global Energy EnergyCents Podcast, “The Graphite Gap: Reshoring a critical battery
body_markdown:
NOVONIX’ Mike O’Kronley was featured on the latest episode of the S&P Global Energy EnergyCents Podcast, “The Graphite Gap: Reshoring a critical battery material” (Ep. 270).


The 38 minute discussion covers key challenges and opportunities facing the U.S. battery materials industry, including:


- The crucial role of synthetic graphite in batteries
- China’s dominance of synthetic graphite production
- Leveling the playing field with strategic tariffs
- The investment case for a U.S. manufacturing resurgence
- The requirements for mass production, including supportive government action
